text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah... It's just you. I thought you
were another
fan.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's a surprising number of my fans
here. Or I
guess, fans of my modeling.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Gotta say, though... Having to smile
through
those conversations is high-key
tiring.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, I don't have to do all that in front of you... I can be the real me.
